Name: The Stardew Squad Law and Order SV Content Pack
Author: sdvhead
Description:
[size=4][b][u]Bring Russell, Shannon, Spork and Ripley on your adventures in Stardew Valley[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3]When using the mod: "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35341]The Stardew Squad[/url]", this content pack adds additional dialogue and idle animations for characters from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23979]Law and Order: SV[/url] expansion.[/size]

[img]data:image/gif;base64,[/img]       [img]data:image/gif;base64,[/img]       [img]data:image/gif;base64,[/img]       [img]data:image/gif;base64,[/img]

[size=4][b][u]Become the Jailer[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3]ALL prisoners from Law and Order SV additionally have dialogue packs enabled for the duration of their stay. With the additional access to the jail cell granted in the mod's 1.4.9 update, take the prisoners for a daytime excursion. Community service hours for them, and [s]free labor[/s] mentoring opportunities for you![/size]
